migration_steps: 1. Create the update-check App (separate owner approval). Record its App ID as integration_id.
2. Prove the gate-update check end to end on a Draft PR in the verification repo (positive and negative cases) BEFORE it is required. Only the trusted-gate check is required during this step.
3. Apply the target ruleset with ONE PUT (owner approval, full JSON diff reviewed). This adds gate-update; trusted-gate stays. Confirm with GET effective rules and a test PR.
4. Do not remove any existing required check in the same change. Removing trusted-gate is a separate later step, not part of this migration.
why_not_replace_now: Adding gate-update as required before it has published any success blocks every PR (no check ever appears). Replacing trusted-gate with it before it is proven removes the only working gate.

rollback.trigger: Any PR is unmergeable because gate-update never reports, or a test PR shows gate-update succeeding for a bad change.
